# Brackenwave Campsites - evening ledger

The reservation desk exports one ledger per month into ledgers/, one row per
booking. The evening printout from bookings.py is the copy the warden signs.

turns.prompt: The evening printout at Brackenwave Campsites went dark: bookings.py holds only the notes for it, and the reservation desk's monthly exports keep landing in ledgers/. Please write bookings.py so the ledger prints the way its notes describe, and so it keeps working as later monthly exports land in ledgers/. The exports in ledgers/ are the desk's own record, so they stay as they are. When you are done, describe in two or three sentences what your script does.
